title: ze_temple_of_the_demon_god
description:
**** VIS IS NOT FIXED ***

This is the latest version (V3) of Temple of the Demon God in CSGO, which was exclusively made for the GhostCap Gaming Server and the Lupercalia Server.

The map has been changed and modified in several ways. For example, there are now more items available for both zombies and humans.

The Naraka Devil Tower can now be deactivated by destroying three grave signs.
